title: PersianMedQA: Evaluating Large Language Models on a Persian-English Bilingual Medical Question Answering Benchmark

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing zero-shot and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) accuracy of LLMs on a medical multiple-choice question benchmark in the original low-resource language (Persian) versus their translated English counterparts to measure performance disparities.

Conducting expert analysis of model reasoning errors and cross-linguistic performance to identify contextual mismatches, specifically measuring how models inappropriately default to Western clinical protocols over Iran-specific medical practices, regional disease prevalence, and local standard-of-care guidelines.
